definition.full: All v3 inclusive works (core + adjacent + role_bridge).
definition.prime: LEGACY audit cut: full minus weak_unlinked. Keeps no_graph. Not the preferred 'integrated' definition (IA-013).
definition.graph_matched: Full minus no_graph (citation roles / degrees defined).
definition.integrated: Graph-matched minus weak_unlinked (in-degree = 0 and in+out ≤ 2). True citation-integrated spine.
definition.rescued_no_graph: no_graph reinstated if ultra_core OR cites ≥ 100 OR (core_relevant AND cites ≥ 50). Flagged rescued_no_graph — not claimed as graph-integrated.
definition.integrated_plus_rescue: Integrated ∪ rescued_no_graph (preferred checkpoint when coverage gaps matter).
